critical_code_review_comments: master_lookup.py /equipment typeahead uses 4-field $or on regex (unit_number/make_model/vin/serial_number) without text index — fine for the current 50-item master fleet, but if equipment_master grows past ~5k docs add a compound text index or restrict to unit_number/make_model.

Backfill /equipment matches by uppercased unit_number ONLY. Records that store 'truck' or 'equipment_unit' free-text in formats other than unit_number (e.g. 'CAT 320', 'Bobcat #5') will end up in unresolved without a fallback strategy. Consider a 2nd pass matching make_model substring.

Backfill /employees resolution order is email → employee_id → full-name. Full-name match is case-insensitive but exact-match only; 'Mike Johnson' won't match 'Michael Johnson' or 'Johnson, Mike'. Acceptable for now; flag if unresolved counts stay high.

/audit endpoint computes coverage by counting docs with equipment_master_id existing AND non-empty — note the {'$ne': ''} catches empty strings but not nulls explicitly; if any record sets the field to null the count will be off. Current code is correct for the current data shape; just a defensive note.

All 4 master-lookup endpoints are mounted directly with prefix='/api/master-lookup' instead of going through the canonical /api router in server.py — works fine (FastAPI lets routers stack) but inconsistent with the rest of the codebase where routes/* files use a relative prefix and server.py prepends /api. Minor consistency nit.

PortalStates EmptyState wiring on the 3 safety pages is identical pattern (icon + title + body + testId) — good DRY. Consider extracting a SafetyListPage<T> shell once 5+ safety list pages share the loading/empty/error triad.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (3/3 empty-state testids source-verified; 8/9 mobile pages overflow=0, 1 page has 1px subpixel)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter137_master_lookup.py is the regression suite for Iter C-continued (Master SOT). It covers typeahead (with the agent-noted T-1 and 'jay' fixtures), empty-q guard, admin gating, dry-run no-mutation invariant, real-run idempotency, employee backfill, and 4 regression checks (training-center=18, deploy-readiness=ready, 2 safety lists). conftest.py auto-attaches admin token, so the 'no auth' test for typeahead uses an explicit invalid X-Admin-Token header to override; the 'admin required' test for /audit also uses an invalid token header (not absence). When testing the FE empty states for safety pages, the testids only render when the filtered list is empty — either delete all rows in the collection OR enter a no-match filter string in the UI to force them. Source-grep verified the testids are wired correctly in all 3 pages.
rca of the issue: One failing assertion on first run: /api/training-center/portals does NOT return a top-level 'total' field — it returns portals[] with per-portal 'count' fields. Fixed the test to sum portal counts when 'total' is missing. All 15 now pass. No backend or frontend code changes required.
